activity.notes: Wu Ding is securely attested by contemporary Shang oracle-bone inscriptions. Absolute regnal chronology remains debated; ATLAS uses the Xia-Shang-Zhou Chronology Project's c.1250-1192 BCE reconstruction as an approximate reign interval, consistent with radiocarbon results centered on the mid-thirteenth to late-twelfth century BCE.

sources.title: Radiocarbon Dating of Oracle Bones of Late Shang Period in Ancient China
sources.citation_text: Radiocarbon analysis of oracle bones associated with Wu Ding gives a calibrated reign range around 1254-1197 BCE and discusses the 1250-1192 BCE astronomical chronology.

sources.title: The Veritable Records of King Sejong — Glossary: Wu Ding
sources.citation_text: The Korean historical glossary identifies Wu Ding (武丁, 무정) as a Shang king and one of the earliest Chinese figures confirmed by oracle-bone inscriptions.
